escape_asterisks off leaves asterisks in a table cell unescaped

```elixir title="Elixir"
options_value = %HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptions{escape_asterisks: false}
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><td>2*3 = 6</td></tr></table>", options_value)
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
